classification.difficultyReason: Combine workforce, duration and distance at a constant working rate, then round the required workforce up to a whole person.

content.prompt: If it takes 4 people 5 days to clean up the rubbish alongside a 180 km stretch of freeway, how many people will be needed to clean 250 km of freeway in 6 days? (Assume they all work at the same pace.)

answer.short:
5 people.

Find the distance one person cleans in 6 days, then divide 250 km by that distance and round up.
answer.worked:
One person cleans the following distance in one day:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Distance per person per day}&=\frac{180}{4\times5}\\\text{Distance per person per day}&=9\text{ km}.\end{align*}$$
In 6 days, one person cleans $9\times6=54\text{ km}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number of people required}&=\frac{250}{54}\\\text{Number of people required}&=\frac{125}{27}=4\frac{17}{27}.\end{align*}$$
A whole number of people is needed. Round up: **5 people**.
